name: Reactor Pour
hint: Select a source tube, then a matching or empty destination. Pour contiguous colors together.

name: Marble Bureau
hint: Move one top marble at a time. A full tube must contain just one color.

name: Gap Shuffle
hint: Tap a tile next to the gap. Restore 1 to 8 in reading order.

name: Crate Date
hint: Push the crate onto GO. Tap a neighboring floor tile or use arrows. Undo a bad push.

name: Safe Tiles
hint: Four mines hide in the grid. Use the revealed numbers, flag suspicious tiles, reveal every safe tile.

name: Pocket Packing
hint: Choose a shape, rotate if needed, then tap its top-left board position. Fill every square.

name: Count The Ink
hint: Fill tiles to match every row and column group count. Tapping again clears a tile.

name: Number Train
hint: Append matching dominoes to open end 0. Use every tile and finish at 3.

name: Pipe Dream
hint: Tap a pipe to rotate it clockwise. Connect the left inlet to the right outlet.

name: Mirror Mail
hint: Flip slash mirrors to route the beam into the lower-left receiver.

name: Crossfire Board
hint: You are X. Place a mark in an empty cell. Win or draw against the minimax opponent.

name: Drop Duel
hint: You are red. Tap a column to drop a disk. Connect four before the blue opponent does.

name: Honey Circuit
hint: Rotate hex pipes. Water must visit all six outer tiles before reaching the blue hub.

name: Warm Words
hint: Change one letter at a time. Turn COLD into WARM within eight moves.

name: Disk Delivery
hint: Select a peg, then another peg. Move all disks right; never cover a smaller disk.

name: Weather Twins
hint: Flip two weather cards. Remember mismatches and clear all four pairs.

name: Double Trouble
hint: The knight moves two squares, then one. Find a square attacking the red king and rook together.

name: Knight Shift
hint: Visit all twelve tiles using knight moves. A trapped knight loses; undo before the final trap.

name: Goat Boat
hint: Carry wolf, goat and cabbage right. Sail with one passenger or empty. Do not leave hungry pairs alone.

name: Last Peg Standing
hint: Select a peg and an empty hole two spaces away. Capture the peg between them. Leave one.

name: Whose Tool
hint: Read both clues. Give each hero one different tool: FIX means wrench, SWEEP means broom, OPEN means key.

name: Siding Shuffle
hint: Move the next IN car to a siding or dispatch. Sidings are last-in-first-out. Dispatch A, B, C.

name: Gate Keeper
hint: Toggle A through D to make each logic output match its required value. XOR means different inputs.

name: Gear School
hint: Choose a gear radius, then a hub. Meshing gear radii add up to the distance between their hubs.

name: Color Vault
hint: Tap four pegs to cycle colors, then CHECK. Exact counts correct positions; wrong spot counts other matches.
